package.name: aries_science
package.description: The science module's sensors, published under names instead of array indices. The board itself (firmware/teensy_science_sys, a SECOND Teensy separate from the drill's) sends one Float32MultiArray of ten values on /science/telemetry, in a fixed order that carries no names -- so this package holds the node that splits it into named topics, and the field table that defines what that order is.
